changes.title: AI Agent node version 1 removed
changes.message: AI Agent node version 1.x is removed in n8n 3.0, along with its agent modes (SQL, Conversational, OpenAI Functions, Plan and Execute, ReAct).
changes.replacement: Update the node to the latest AI Agent version (Tools Agent behaves the same). For SQL Agent, use a Postgres or MySQL tool sub-node with a recent AI Agent.
changes.note: The docs say "version 1"; n8n source maps typeVersions 1 to 1.9 to the V1 implementation, so all 1.x versions are flagged.

changes.title: Execute Sub-workflow: Local File and URL sources removed
changes.message: The "Local File" and "URL" sources of the Execute Sub-workflow node are removed in n8n 3.0; nodes using them fail with an error.
changes.replacement: Import the sub-workflow and select it with the "Database" source, or paste its JSON with "Define Below" ("Parameter" on node versions 1.1 and older).

changes.title: $getPairedItem helper removed
changes.message: The $getPairedItem expression helper is removed in n8n 3.0.
changes.replacement: Use item linking instead: the pairedItem property or $("<node-name>").item.

changes.title: $evaluateExpression() removed from the Code node
changes.message: $evaluateExpression() is removed from the Code node (JavaScript) in n8n 3.0. Secure-mode task runners, the default since n8n 2.0, already fail on this call.
changes.replacement: Evaluate the expression in a node field (for example an Edit Fields (Set) node before the Code node) and read the result from the input item.

changes.title: Gmail Trigger versions 1 to 1.3 run as version 1.4
changes.message: Gmail Trigger versions below 1.4 run with version 1.4 behavior in n8n 3.0: Max Emails per Poll applies (default 10), drafts are skipped unless "Include Drafts" is on, and sent or scheduled emails outside the inbox no longer trigger.
changes.replacement: Turn on "Include Drafts" if the workflow relies on drafts; for sent or scheduled emails, use a Schedule Trigger followed by the Gmail node's "Get Many" messages operation.

changes.title: Always Output Data on nodes with several outputs
changes.unverifiedNote: The docs page names If and Switch as examples of "nodes with several outputs". Compare Datasets (4 outputs) and Loop Over Items v3 (2 outputs) have several outputs in n8n source but are not named on the page.
changes.message: With "Always Output Data" on, n8n 3.0 adds an empty item only when every output is empty; before, each empty output got one, so other branches ran.
changes.replacement: Review the node and adjust "Always Output Data" to match your intent.

changes.title: Webflow OAuth2 credential: Legacy toggle off by default
changes.message: The Webflow OAuth2 credential's "Legacy" toggle defaults to off in n8n 3.0. Credentials that never saved it request v2 scopes on reconnect, which a legacy Webflow v1 app rejects.
changes.replacement: Turn on "Legacy" on the Webflow OAuth2 credential before reconnecting it, or move the node to version 2.

changes.title: Chat Trigger: WebSocket messages are JSON frames
changes.message: In "Using Response Nodes" mode, the chat WebSocket now sends every frame as JSON with a "type" field; custom clients expecting raw strings break.
changes.replacement: Parse every frame as JSON and switch on "type", or update an embedded @n8n/chat widget to 1.31.0 or later.

changes.title: Lower Compression node decompression limits
changes.message: Default decompression limits drop to 256 MiB (from 2 GiB) and 1,000 ZIP entries (from 5,000) in n8n 3.0; larger archives fail.
changes.replacement: Set N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE_BYTES=2147483648 and N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_ZIP_ENTRIES=5000 if you decompress larger archives.

openai.matching: Model IDs and listed aliases match exactly. Entries from the "Model family / snapshot" table (matchDatedSnapshots) also match dated snapshots such as <id>-2025-08-28. Fine-tuned IDs (ft:<base>:...) are matched to the page's ft-<base> labels by base-model prefix; those matches are reported as unverified.
openai.excluded: Rows that are not model IDs are left out: endpoints (/v1/...), API products (Assistants API, Videos API, Evals, Agent Builder, reusable prompts), OpenAI-Beta headers, and fine-tuning training restrictions.
